goal: Use a reload diagnostic to repair malformed configuration.
initial_conditions: Fresh virtual workspace containing only the listed fixtures; configuration is inactive until reloaded.

files.docs/extensions.md: config/hello.json must be strict JSON with a template string containing {name}. eval_reload validates it, eval_probe target="hello" input="Ada" invokes it.

steps.content: First call eval_reload to inspect the existing configuration. Read its error and docs/extensions.md, repair the file, reload again and invoke the greeting for Ada. Return only the greeting.
